name: com.faolline.graphquest
description: Quest & objective domain library above com.faolline.graphcore and com.faolline.graphstandard. Quests and objectives whose states (Locked/Active/Completed/Failed) are derived from the shared BaseContext: prerequisite gating (linear chains AND DAGs, on graphstandard's ReactiveEvaluator), completion/fail conditions (graphcore BaseConditions), and one-shot reward hooks (graphcore BaseActions). Code-first fluent builder. All state lives in context collections, so it persists for free through com.faolline.graphsave and runs against any host context (no gameflow dependency).
